description: Address 3 issues from v2 review: (1) escapeLike must escape backslash before other metacharacters, (2) onboarding pipeline deletion must handle FK constraint on deals.stageId, (3) deals endpoint cache key pollution must be removed like contacts.
steps: Fix lib/api/sanitize-like.ts: add .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\') as the FIRST replacement before % and _
Fix app/api/tenant/onboarding/route.ts: instead of delete-and-recreate, update the existing pipeline in place - update name, delete old stages (reassigning deals first), then insert new stages
Fix app/api/tenant/deals/route.ts: remove cache.get() and cache.set() from GET handler, remove cache import if unused (keep cache.delByPattern in POST)
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding pipeline update does not violate FK constraints when deals exist
Deals GET endpoint does not use cache.get/cache.set with raw query string key
